question.text: Per the current NISM IX (Merchant Banking) workbook, what is the minimum gap that an issuer must maintain before launching a subsequent QIP after a prior QIP?

explanation.text: The Logic: The current NISM IX workbook (January 2026) states that the issuer shall not make a subsequent QIP until the expiry of 2 weeks from the prior QIP. The legacy 6-month cooling-off is no longer the rule. The Trap: 12 months is the lock-in period for QIP allottees (except QIB MFs); 6 months reflects the older inter-QIP gap. These are different parameters. Cross-Exam Context: NISM IX tests the distinction between QIP allottee lock-in (1 year), the inter-QIP gap (2 weeks under the current workbook), and the special-resolution validity period.
